Overview & City Profile

Baekseok-dong (백석2동) is a municipality in Gyeonggi Province, Gyeonggi Province (coordinates 37.5792°N, 126.6705°E; population Local Municipality). Visitors use Baekseok-dong as a base to explore Gyeonggi Province's historic town centers, regional markets, and culinary specialties such as Suwon Wang Galbi (marinated beef ribs), Icheon rice feast (Hanjeongsik), Uijeongbu Budae-jjigae.

Within Gyeonggi Province Region (Gyeonggi Province region), Baekseok-dong (백석2동) serves as a administrative city / district in gyeonggi province region. Travelers exploring Gyeonggi Province often combine a stop in Baekseok-dong with regional highlights such as Suwon Hwaseong Fortress (UNESCO), DMZ & Panmunjom (Paju), Korean Folk Village (Yongin), Gapyeong & Nami Island gateway.

Getting to Baekseok-dong & Getting Around

Via the regional hub (Suwon Central Station (KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail)): Directly integrated with Seoul Metropolitan Subway, GTX high-speed commuter rail, and KTX via Suwon & Gwangmyeong.

  • Local rail & IC cards: Once in Gyeonggi Province Region, JR regional lines and local private railways connect Suwon with Baekseok-dong. Nationwide IC cards (Transit Card, Pasmo, Icoca) work on major urban and JR commuter gates; for rural branch lines or local buses, keep ₩1,000 bills and ₩100 coins handy for the onboard fare box.
  • Luggage & station lockers: Main stations in Gyeonggi Province have coin lockers for day-trippers. If you are stopping in Baekseok-dong en route between larger bases, check your suitcase dimensions in our Luggage & Locker Checker or forward big bags ahead with Takkyubin.
  • Driving & car rental: While city centers around Baekseok-dong are accessible by train and taxi, renting a car from a major KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail station or airport in Gyeonggi Province can be rewarding for reaching mountain gorges, coastal viewpoints, and countryside onsen. Read our Renting a Car in South Korea Guide.

What to Eat in Baekseok-dong & Gyeonggi Province

Baekseok-dong shares the culinary traditions of Gyeonggi Province Region and the wider Gyeonggi Province region. Don't miss these local specialties during your visit:

  • Suwon Wang Galbi (marinated beef ribs) — a signature specialty across Gyeonggi Province Region.
  • Icheon rice feast (Hanjeongsik) — a signature specialty across Gyeonggi Province Region.
  • Uijeongbu Budae-jjigae — a signature specialty across Gyeonggi Province Region.
  • Paju soybean dishes — a signature specialty across Gyeonggi Province Region.

Best Time to Visit & Seasonal Highlights

Best time to visit Gyeonggi Province: Apr–May, Sep–Nov.

Regional highlights across Gyeonggi Province Region that pair well with a visit to Baekseok-dong include: Suwon Hwaseong Fortress (UNESCO), DMZ & Panmunjom (Paju), Korean Folk Village (Yongin), Gapyeong & Nami Island gateway.

Practical Travel Tips for Baekseok-dong

  • Tourist information center (観光案内所): Look for the Kankō Annaijo counter inside or right outside the main train station in Baekseok-dong (or at Suwon Central Station (KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail)) for free walking maps, bus timetables, and festival calendars.
  • Cash & ATMs: While hotels, chain stores, and convenience stores in Baekseok-dong accept international cards and IC payment, smaller family-run restaurants, shrines, and rural buses often prefer cash. 7-Eleven (Seven Bank) and South Korea Post ATMs accept foreign debit cards reliably.
  • Dining hours: Outside major metropolitan hubs, lunch typically runs 11:30 AM–2:00 PM and dinner spots open around 5:30 PM, with earlier last orders (around 8:00–9:00 PM) in smaller cities.

Frequently asked questions

Where is Baekseok-dong (백석2동) located in South Korea?

Baekseok-dong (백석2동) is a administrative city / district located in Gyeonggi Province Region in the Gyeonggi Province region of South Korea (coordinates: 37.5792°N, 126.6705°E). It has a population of approximately Local Municipality across an area of Regional km².

How do I get to Baekseok-dong by train?

Most visitors reach Baekseok-dong via the main prefectural gateway of Suwon Central Station (KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail). Directly integrated with Seoul Metropolitan Subway, GTX high-speed commuter rail, and KTX via Suwon & Gwangmyeong. From the regional hub, connect by JR local/rapid lines, private commuter railways, or local bus to Baekseok-dong. You can estimate long-distance rail costs using our KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail Fare Calculator.

What local food is Baekseok-dong and Gyeonggi Province known for?

In Baekseok-dong and across Gyeonggi Province Region, top local dishes include Suwon Wang Galbi (marinated beef ribs), Icheon rice feast (Hanjeongsik), Uijeongbu Budae-jjigae, as well as Paju soybean dishes. Look for local ekiben (station bento boxes), morning markets, and family-run shokudo near the main station.

When is the best time of year to visit Baekseok-dong?

Best time to visit Gyeonggi Province: Apr–May, Sep–Nov. Check our South Korea Seasonal Calendar to compare month-by-month weather and crowd levels.
